compiled_state.title: As a project maintainer, CI overlay agents fire in parallel with the main tier reviewer, matching local /dso:review dispatch behavior
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Close the overlay dispatch timing gap between local /dso:review and CI llm-review.

In local REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4, the tier reviewer and all classifier-flagged overlay agents are dispatched in the same parallel batch. In ci-llm-review-runner.sh, overlays are dispatched only after the tier reviewer's response is received and FINDINGS_JSON is set — adding an unnecessary round-trip of latency for every overlay-flagged PR.

The pattern for parallel dispatch already exists in the runner: the deep-tier dispatches 3 specialist llm-api-call.sh calls with `&` followed by `wait`. The overlay dispatch block should follow the same pattern, launching overlay calls with `&` at the same time as the main tier call.

**Scope**:
- IN: For light and standard tiers, the main tier llm-api-call.sh call and all active overlay calls are launched in parallel (`&`); a single `wait` block waits for all of them before proceeding to merge.
- IN: For deep tier, the 3 specialist calls (already parallel) AND all active overlay calls are launched in the same parallel group; the arch synthesis step runs after all specialist + overlay calls complete.
- IN: Security blue-team remains serial after red-team (blue-team reads red-team findings — this ordering is load-bearing and is preserved).
- OUT: Any changes to the overlay merge logic (scores/findings merge) — unchanged.
- OUT: Changes to overlay agent files — unchanged.

## Done Definitions

- When complete, for a light or standard tier review with at least one overlay active, the main tier llm-api-call.sh invocation and each overlay llm-api-call.sh invocation are launched concurrently (`&`); the runner does not start parsing the tier response until all parallel calls have returned; verified by a test that counts concurrent curl processes during a mocked multi-overlay review run.
- When complete, for a deep tier review with overlays active, the 3 specialist calls and overlay calls all run in the same parallel batch; arch synthesis starts only after all of them complete; verified by test.
- When complete, the security blue-team agent continues to run serially after the red-team agent (not in the parallel batch); verified by test asserting ordering.
- When complete, total wall-clock latency for a light-tier review with 2 overlays is bounded by max(tier\_latency, overlay\_latency) rather than tier\_latency + overlay\_latency; verified by timing assertion in test using mocked sleep calls.
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.
